intro: Start with the account’s sites. Use the site ID for build, branch and certificate lookups; use the DNS zone ID when the question concerns a record rather than a deployment.

operations.title: Account site inventory
operations.note: Find a site under a particular team before investigating its build history. An account slug and a site ID identify different resources.

operations.title: Site build history
operations.note: Compare recent attempts for one site. A finished build is evidence about the build process; the published deploy is a separate object.

operations.title: Deployed branches
operations.note: Find branches with deployment history. A missing feature branch may exist in Git without ever having produced a Netlify deploy.

operations.title: Individual site deployment
operations.note: Inspect the deploy attached to a particular site, especially when two builds use the same branch name. Match the deploy ID before comparing results.

operations.title: Site TLS certificate
operations.note: Check the certificate associated with a site during a custom-domain rollout. Compare its hostnames with the exact address a visitor opens.

operations.title: DNS zone records
operations.note: Inventory records in the selected Netlify DNS zone. First verify the domain delegates to that zone; an old zone can still contain plausible records.

operations.title: Published site files
operations.note: Check whether an expected asset path appears in the site file inventory. A missing file points to build output or publishing configuration rather than browser caching.

operations.title: Build plugin runs
operations.note: Look for a plugin run corresponding to a recent build. Compare the plugin outcome with the deploy outcome before attributing a failed release to the plugin.

intro: Use a service ID for deployments and domains. For runtime investigations select the relevant resource and time window before comparing CPU, memory or HTTP measurements.

operations.title: Service deployment history
operations.note: Locate the release nearest a reported regression. Compare deploy times with the incident window before interpreting resource metrics.

parameters.description: The ID of the service

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter for deploys with the specified statuses

parameters.name: createdBefore
parameters.description: Filter for deploys created before a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp)

parameters.name: createdAfter
parameters.description: Filter for deploys created after a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp)

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description: Filter for deploys updated before a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp)

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description: Filter for deploys updated after a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp)

parameters.name: finishedBefore
parameters.description: Filter for deploys finished before a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp)

parameters.name: finishedAfter
parameters.description: Filter for deploys finished after a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp)

parameters.description: The position in the result list to start from when fetching paginated results. For details, see [Pagination](https://api-docs.render.com/reference/pagination).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return. For details, see [Pagination](https://api-docs.render.com/reference/pagination).

operations.title: Custom domain inventory
operations.note: Check which hostnames belong to the selected service. A Render association alone does not prove that public DNS currently points to Render.

parameters.name: serviceId
parameters.description: The ID of the service

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The position in the result list to start from when fetching paginated results. For details, see [Pagination](https://api-docs.render.com/reference/pagination).

parameters.name: limit

operations.title: Persistent disk snapshots
operations.note: Identify snapshots for a particular disk before planning recovery. Listing a snapshot does not restore it or test its contents.

parameters.name: diskId
parameters.description: The ID of the disk

operations.title: CPU measurements
operations.note: Inspect processor usage during a slow interval. Compare it with the CPU limit and request volume; high utilization by itself does not identify the slow endpoint.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Epoch/Unix timestamp of start of time range to return. Defaults to `now() - 1 hour`.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: Epoch/Unix timestamp of end of time range to return. Defaults to `now()`.

parameters.name: resolutionSeconds
parameters.description: The resolution of the returned data

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: Resource ID to query. When multiple resource query params are provided, they are ORed together. Resources can be service ids, Postgres ids, or Redis ids

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: This parameter is deprecated. Please use `resource` instead

parameters.name: instance
parameters.description: Instance ID to query. When multiple instance ID query params are provided, they are ORed together

parameters.name: aggregationMethod
parameters.description: The aggregation method to apply to multiple time series

operations.title: Memory usage
operations.note: Check whether memory climbed before a service became unstable. Keep the instance set and time window consistent when comparing against the memory limit.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Epoch/Unix timestamp of start of time range to return. Defaults to `now() - 1 hour`.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: Epoch/Unix timestamp of end of time range to return. Defaults to `now()`.

operations.title: HTTP latency
operations.note: Look for response-time changes near a deploy. Compare the same service and aggregation interval before treating a short spike as a sustained slowdown.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Epoch/Unix timestamp of start of time range to return. Defaults to `now() - 1 hour`.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: Epoch/Unix timestamp of end of time range to return. Defaults to `now()`.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: The hosts of HTTP requests to filter to. When multiple host query params are provided, they are ORed together

parameters.name: path

parameters.name: quantile
parameters.description: The quantile of latencies to fetch. When multiple quantile query params are provided, they are ORed together

operations.title: HTTP request volume
operations.note: Determine whether a latency spike coincided with higher request volume. Use a comparable interval; a larger time bucket can hide brief bursts.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Epoch/Unix timestamp of start of time range to return. Defaults to `now() - 1 hour`.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: Epoch/Unix timestamp of end of time range to return. Defaults to `now()`.

parameters.name: aggregateBy
parameters.description: The field to aggregate by

operations.title: Service instance count
operations.note: Check whether scaling changed the number of instances during an incident. Interpret aggregate CPU or memory alongside that count.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Epoch/Unix timestamp of start of time range to return. Defaults to `now() - 1 hour`.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: Epoch/Unix timestamp of end of time range to return. Defaults to `now()`.

intro: App Platform distinguishes the application, its deployments and its running instances. Choose the app first, then narrow the investigation to a rollout, alert or component.

operations.title: App Platform applications
operations.note: Find the application in the connected account. Similar app names are common across environments, so use the returned app ID for subsequent requests.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Which 'page' of paginated results to return.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of items returned per page

parameters.name: with_projects
parameters.description: Whether the project_id of listed apps should be fetched and included.

operations.title: App rollout history
operations.note: Identify which rollout preceded a change in site behavior. Keep failed attempts separate from the deployment that actually took traffic.

parameters.name: app_id
parameters.description: The app ID

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Which 'page' of paginated results to return.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of items returned per page

parameters.name: deployment_types
parameters.description: Optional. Filter deployments by deployment_type - MANUAL: manual deployment - DEPLOY_ON_PUSH: deployment triggered by a push to the app's repository - MAINTENANCE: deployment for maintenance purposes - MANUAL_ROLLBACK: manual revert to a previous deployment - AUTO_ROLLBACK: automatic revert to a previous deployment - UPDATE_DATABASE_TRUSTED_SOURCES: update database trusted sources - AUTOSCALED: d…

operations.title: Deployment detail
operations.note: Inspect a single rollout rather than assuming the first item in a changing list is the one under investigation.

parameters.name: app_id
parameters.description: The app ID

parameters.name: deployment_id
parameters.description: The deployment ID

operations.title: Configured app alerts
operations.note: Review the alerts configured on an app. An alert definition describes a monitored condition; it is not evidence that the condition is currently firing.

parameters.name: app_id
parameters.description: The app ID

operations.title: Daily app bandwidth
operations.note: Compare transferred data across complete days. A day still in progress is a poor baseline for diagnosing a sudden drop.

parameters.name: app_id
parameters.description: The app ID

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Optional day to query. Only the date component of the timestamp will be considered. Default: yesterday.

operations.title: App health
operations.note: Read the provider’s view of application health. Follow it with an external hostname check if the report concerns DNS, TLS or a regional outage.

parameters.name: app_id
parameters.description: The app ID

operations.title: Available App Platform regions
operations.note: Look up region options while planning a deployment. The list describes possible locations, not the region currently serving an existing app.

operations.title: App instances
operations.note: See which instances belong to an application before comparing logs. An instance that disappeared after a rollout may not exist in the current set.

parameters.name: app_id
parameters.description: The app ID

intro: A Fly app contains Machines; persistent volumes and IP assignments have their own lifecycles. Resolve the app name first and track Machine and volume IDs separately.

operations.title: Organization app inventory
operations.note: Find an application under the intended organization before looking for Machines. A Machine ID is not a substitute for the app name in a scoped route.

parameters.name: org_slug
parameters.description: The org slug, or 'personal', to filter apps

parameters.name: app_role
parameters.description: Filter apps by role

operations.title: Assigned IP addresses
operations.note: Compare the addresses allocated to the app with its published DNS. An assignment does not establish that a particular hostname resolves to it.

parameters.name: app_name
parameters.description: Fly App Name

operations.title: Machine event history
operations.note: Match lifecycle events to the time of a restart. Events can explain when a Machine changed state without explaining an application-level exception.

parameters.name: app_name
parameters.description: Fly App Name

parameters.name: machine_id
parameters.description: Machine ID

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of events to fetch (max of 50). If omitted, this is set to 20 by default.

operations.title: Machine configuration versions
operations.note: Identify revisions to one Machine’s configuration. Compare the relevant version with the incident time rather than treating the latest version as historical evidence.

parameters.name: app_name
parameters.description: Fly App Name

parameters.name: machine_id
parameters.description: Machine ID

operations.title: Processes on a Machine
operations.note: Check the process inventory for the Machine in question. A process appearing in this snapshot does not establish that its HTTP health check is passing.

parameters.name: app_name
parameters.description: Fly App Name

parameters.name: machine_id
parameters.description: Machine ID

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Sort by

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Order

operations.title: App certificates
operations.note: List the hostnames with certificates attached to the app. Use DNS and certificate status together when a new custom domain still fails HTTPS.

parameters.name: app_name
parameters.description: Fly App Name

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Hostname filter (substring match)

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from previous response

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of results per page (default 25, max 500)

operations.title: App storage volumes
operations.note: Inventory volumes before moving a workload. Check the region and attachment of the intended volume rather than relying on a reused display name.

parameters.name: app_name
parameters.description: Fly App Name

parameters.name: summary
parameters.description: Only return summary info about volumes (omit blocks, block size, etc)

operations.title: Volume snapshot history
operations.note: Locate a recovery point for one volume. Compare the snapshot time with the first bad write before choosing a recovery candidate.

parameters.name: app_name
parameters.description: Fly App Name

parameters.name: volume_id
parameters.description: Volume ID

intro: Firebase Hosting separates projects, sites, channels, releases and immutable versions. Use the complete resource name returned by the parent list rather than assembling it from a public hostname.

operations.title: Project hosting sites
operations.note: Find the site resource for the website you are inspecting. A Firebase project may contain multiple sites with separate releases and custom domains.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: Required. The Firebase project for which to list sites, in the format: projects/PROJECT_IDENTIFIER Refer to the `Site` [`name`](../projects#Site.FIELDS.name) field for details about PROJECT_IDENTIFIER values.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: Optional. A token from a previous call to `ListSites` that tells the server where to resume listing.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Optional. The maximum number of sites to return. The service may return a lower number if fewer sites exist than this maximum number. If unspecified, defaults to 40.

operations.title: Preview channel inventory
operations.note: Identify the preview channel that owns a URL. Activity on a preview channel does not by itself change the live channel.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of channels to return. The service may return a lower number if fewer channels exist than this maximum number. If unspecified, defaults to 10. The maximum value is 100; values above 100 will be coerced to 100.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: A token from a previous call to `ListChannels` that tells the server where to resume listing.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: Required. The site for which to list channels, in the format: sites/SITE_ID

operations.title: Preview channel detail
operations.note: Inspect one channel by its resource name when a preview link behaves unexpectedly. Confirm the channel belongs to the intended site.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Required. The fully-qualified resource name for the channel, in the format: sites/SITE_ID/channels/CHANNEL_ID

operations.title: Channel release history
operations.note: Follow a preview deployment through the releases for that channel. Avoid comparing its history with the site’s live release list.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: Required. The site or channel for which to list releases, in either of the following formats: - sites/SITE_ID - sites/SITE_ID/channels/CHANNEL_ID

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of releases to return. The service may return a lower number if fewer releases exist than this maximum number. If unspecified, defaults to 100.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: A token from a previous call to `releases.list` or `channels.releases.list` that tells the server where to resume listing.

operations.title: Site release history
operations.note: Determine when a version was released to the site. A version can exist before a release points users to it.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of releases to return. The service may return a lower number if fewer releases exist than this maximum number. If unspecified, defaults to 100.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: A token from a previous call to `releases.list` or `channels.releases.list` that tells the server where to resume listing.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: Required. The site or channel for which to list releases, in either of the following formats: - sites/SITE_ID - sites/SITE_ID/channels/CHANNEL_ID

operations.title: Files in a hosting version
operations.note: Check a specific version’s file manifest for an expected path. Verify the release points to this version before diagnosing a public 404.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of version files to return. The service may return a lower number if fewer version files exist than this maximum number. If unspecified, defaults to 1000.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: A token from a previous call to `ListVersionFiles` that tells the server where to resume listing.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: The type of files that should be listed for the specified version.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: Required. The version for which to list files, in the format: sites/SITE_ID /versions/VERSION_ID

operations.title: Custom domain bindings
operations.note: Review the custom domains assigned to a site. A binding can exist while DNS changes or certificate provisioning are still incomplete.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The max number of `CustomDomain` entities to return in a request. Defaults to 10.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: A token from a previous call to `ListCustomDomains` that tells the server where to resume listing.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: Required. The Firebase Hosting `Site` with `CustomDomain` entities you'd like to list.

parameters.name: showDeleted
parameters.description: If true, the request returns soft-deleted `CustomDomain`s that haven't been fully-deleted yet. To restore deleted `CustomDomain`s, make an `UndeleteCustomDomain` request.

operations.title: Custom domain operation progress
operations.note: Find pending provider operations for a domain that has not finished setup. An accepted operation and a completed domain transition are different states.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: The standard list filter.

parameters.name: returnPartialSuccess
parameters.description: When set to `true`, operations that are reachable are returned as normal, and those that are unreachable are returned in the ListOperationsResponse.unreachable field. This can only be `true` when reading across collections. For example, when `parent` is set to `"projects/example/locations/-"`. This field is not supported by default and will result in an `UNIMPLEMENTED` error if set unless explici…

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: The standard list page token.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the operation's parent resource.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The standard list page size.

intro: Amplify app IDs belong to a region. After selecting the app, use branch names for jobs and domain names for associations; a backend environment is a separate resource.

operations.title: Regional app inventory
operations.note: Find an Amplify app in the selected AWS region. An empty result in one region does not mean the app was deleted from the account.

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: A pagination token. If non-null, the pagination token is returned in a result. Pass its value in another request to retrieve more entries.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of records to list in a single response.

operations.title: Connected branches
operations.note: Check which repository branches Amplify knows about for this app. A branch in Git does not imply that Amplify builds it.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique ID for an Amplify app.

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: A pagination token. Set to null to start listing branches from the start. If a non-null pagination token is returned in a result, pass its value in here to list more branches.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of records to list in a single response.

operations.title: Branch job history
operations.note: Look for a job on the branch that serves the affected environment. Jobs from another branch can have similar commit messages and different outcomes.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique ID for an Amplify app.

parameters.name: branchName
parameters.description: The name of the branch to use for the request.

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: A pagination token. Set to null to start listing steps from the start. If a non-null pagination token is returned in a result, pass its value in here to list more steps.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of records to list in a single response.

operations.title: Build job steps
operations.note: Follow a single job through its steps. Use the step state to distinguish a build failure from a later deployment or verification problem.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique ID for an Amplify app.

parameters.name: branchName
parameters.description: The name of the branch to use for the job.

parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: The unique ID for the job.

operations.title: Domain association status
operations.note: Inspect one custom domain’s relationship to the app. Compare the mapped branch with the one you released before changing DNS.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique id for an Amplify app.

parameters.name: domainName
parameters.description: The name of the domain.

operations.title: Domains attached to an app
operations.note: Inventory attached domains during a migration. A domain can be present even when an individual subdomain points at a different branch.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique ID for an Amplify app.

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: A pagination token. Set to null to start listing apps from the start. If non-null, a pagination token is returned in a result. Pass its value in here to list more projects.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of records to list in a single response.

operations.title: Backend environment inventory
operations.note: Check which backend environments exist for an app before comparing staging and production. Their names need not match the frontend branch names.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique ID for an Amplify app.

parameters.name: environmentName
parameters.description: The name of the backend environment

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: A pagination token. Set to null to start listing backend environments from the start. If a non-null pagination token is returned in a result, pass its value in here to list more backend environments.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of records to list in a single response.

operations.title: Resource tags
operations.note: Inspect ownership or environment labels assigned to the resource ARN. Tags are useful identifiers but do not prove which branch receives production traffic.

parameters.name: resourceArn
parameters.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) to use to list tags.

intro: Separate registration, transfer and DNS questions. Most domain operations need the registered domain name; a record ID, transfer identifier or TLD is only appropriate for its own resource.

operations.title: Registered domain inventory
operations.note: Find a registration in the connected portfolio. Owning DNS records elsewhere does not prove the registration is held by this account.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Per Page is the number of records to return per request. Per Page defaults to 250.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page is which page to return.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort specifies which domain property to order by.

parameters.name: dir
parameters.description: Dir indicates direction of sort. Possible values are 'asc' (default) or 'desc'.

parameters.name: domainName
parameters.description: DomainName filters domains by exact domain name or wildcard (starts with '*').

parameters.name: tld
parameters.description: Tld filters on specific tld.

parameters.name: locked
parameters.description: Locked filters on locked domains.

parameters.name: createDate
parameters.description: CreateDate filters domains created on this date.

parameters.name: createDateStart
parameters.description: CreateDateStart filters domains created on or after this date.

parameters.name: createDateEnd
parameters.description: CreateDateEnd filters domains created on or before this date.

parameters.name: expireDate
parameters.description: ExpireDate filters domains expiring on this date.

parameters.name: expireDateStart
parameters.description: ExpireDateStart filters domains with expire date on or after this date.

parameters.name: expireDateEnd
parameters.description: ExpireDateEnd filters domains with expire date on or before this date.

parameters.name: privacyEnabled
parameters.description: PrivacyEnabled indicates whether there is a privacy product associated with the domain.

parameters.name: isPremium
parameters.description: IsPremium indicates whether the domain is a premium domain.

parameters.name: autorenewEnabled
parameters.description: AutorenewEnabled indicates if the domain will attempt to renew automatically before expiration.

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: OrderId specifies the order number of a domain purchase.

parameters.name: includeRenewalPrice
parameters.description: IncludeRenewalPrice indicates whether to include renewal pricing information in the response.

operations.title: Hosted DNS records
operations.note: Check the records Name.com holds for a domain. Confirm the delegated nameservers before using this inventory to explain public DNS behavior.

parameters.name: domainName
parameters.description: DomainName is the zone to list the records for.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Per Page is the number of records to return per request. Per Page defaults to 500.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page is which page to return.

operations.title: DNSSEC registrations
operations.note: Review the DNSSEC entries attached to a domain before a DNS-provider migration. Compare the delegation data with the new authoritative operator.

parameters.name: domainName
parameters.description: DomainName is the domain name to list keys for.

operations.title: TLD registration requirements
operations.note: Look up registry-specific requirements while planning a registration. Different suffixes can require different information from the registrant.

parameters.name: tld
parameters.description: TLD indicates which domain requirements to retrieve (without the dot prefix, e.g., 'fr' for .fr domains). For punycode TLDs, use the ASCII version instead of the UTF-8. So for the `онлайн` TLD, you would submit `xn--80asehdb`.

operations.title: Domain-specific pricing
operations.note: Check the price returned for the exact domain and operation you are considering. Do not infer renewal pricing from an introductory registration offer.

parameters.name: domainName
parameters.description: DomainName is the domain to retrieve.

parameters.name: years
parameters.description: Years specifies the registration term to price in years. Defaults to each TLD's minimum registration term if omitted — usually 1 year (2 for `.ai`). Must be a supported registration term for the TLD (commonly 1–10 years). Use the same value on Create Domain when passing `purchasePrice` for `purchaseType: registration`.

operations.title: Transfer eligibility
operations.note: Check whether the provider considers a domain eligible before arranging a transfer. An eligibility result is not an authorization code or an initiated transfer.

parameters.name: domainName
parameters.description: The domain to check transfer eligibility for. Punycode is normalized server-side, so either ASCII or UTF-8 is accepted.

operations.title: Email forwarding rules
operations.note: Identify forwarding rules managed at the registrar before moving mail handling. A listed rule does not confirm the destination mailbox accepts messages.

parameters.name: domainName
parameters.description: DomainName is the domain to list email forwarded boxes for.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: (optional) Per Page is the number of records to return per request. Per Page defaults to 500 if not set.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: (optional) Page is which page to return. Default to page 1 if not set.

operations.title: Vanity nameserver inventory
operations.note: Inspect registered child nameserver hosts. Distinguish these host registrations from the delegation records that choose the active DNS provider.

parameters.name: domainName
parameters.description: The domain name to list vanity nameservers for.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: The number of records to return per page. Defaults to 500.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number to return.

parameters.name: take

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of response items to skip

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: Specifies fields and order to sort the response items

operations.title: Domain availability

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Domain name in ASCII format (A-label) whose details are to be fetched. The domain name must be provided in a fully qualified domain format.

operations.title: Transfer progress
operations.note: Look up the transfer state for one domain before advising someone to retry. A pending transfer can still require action outside the registrar dashboard.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: The domain whose transfer details are to be returned.

operations.title: Personal nameserver hosts
operations.note: List child hosts registered under a domain. These are different from the authoritative nameservers currently selected for the domain itself.

parameters.name: domain

operations.title: Asynchronous operation status
operations.note: Use the operation ID returned by the original request to see whether processing has finished. Submission alone is not confirmation of success.

parameters.name: operationId
parameters.description: Unique ID of async operation

operations.title: Personal nameserver addresses
operations.note: Inspect the registered address information for a particular child host when debugging glue. Verify the exact hostname, not just its parent domain.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Domain name whose details should be fetched. The domain name must be provided in a fully qualified domain format.

parameters.description: The host name part of the nameserver. For example, for `spaceship.dev` domain and `ns1.spaceship.dev` fully qualified name, the host is `ns1`.

intro: GoDaddy exposes both domain portfolio reads and registry reference information. Some routes are account- or plan-restricted; check entitlement before treating a denied response as an absent domain.

operations.title: Account domain portfolio
operations.note: List the registrations visible to the connected account. Use the exact domain from the portfolio rather than a hostname alias used by the website.

parameters.name: X-Shopper-Id
parameters.description: Shopper ID whose domains are to be retrieved

parameters.name: statuses
parameters.description: Only include results with `status` value in the specified set

parameters.name: statusGroups
parameters.description: Only include results with `status` value in any of the specified groups

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of domains to return

parameters.name: marker
parameters.description: Marker Domain to use as the offset in results

parameters.name: includes
parameters.description: Optional details to be included in the response

parameters.name: modifiedDate
parameters.description: Only include results that have been modified since the specified date

operations.title: DNS records by type and name
operations.note: Narrow a DNS lookup to a record name and type. An empty AAAA result does not tell you whether an A record exists for the same host.

parameters.name: X-Shopper-Id
parameters.description: Shopper ID which owns the domain. NOTE: This is only required if you are a Reseller managing a domain purchased outside the scope of your reseller account. For instance, if you're a Reseller, but purchased a Domain via http://www.godaddy.com

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Domain whose DNS Records are to be retrieved

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: DNS Record Type for which DNS Records are to be retrieved

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: DNS Record Name for which DNS Records are to be retrieved

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of results to skip for pagination

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return

operations.title: Domain availability check
operations.note: Check whether a proposed registration is available. This does not reserve the name or establish that the customer is eligible for the suffix.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Domain name whose availability is to be checked

parameters.name: checkType
parameters.description: Optimize for time ('FAST') or accuracy ('FULL')

parameters.name: forTransfer
parameters.description: Whether or not to include domains available for transfer. If set to True, checkType is ignored

operations.title: TLD purchase schema
operations.note: Read which fields a registration request must contain for a suffix. This is a schema lookup, not a purchase or a registration attempt.

parameters.name: tld
parameters.description: The Top-Level Domain whose schema should be retrieved

operations.title: Supported domain suffixes
operations.note: Discover suffixes offered through the API. Support for a TLD does not indicate that a specific label under it is available.

operations.title: Registration agreement lookup
operations.note: Review the applicable agreement set for a proposed transaction. Reading agreements does not record acceptance or commit the account to a purchase.

parameters.name: X-Market-Id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the Market used to retrieve/translate Legal Agreements

parameters.name: tlds
parameters.description: list of TLDs whose legal agreements are to be retrieved

parameters.name: privacy
parameters.description: Whether or not privacy has been requested

parameters.name: forTransfer
parameters.description: Whether or not domain tranfer has been requested

operations.title: Registry maintenance windows
operations.note: Check reported maintenance before retrying a registry action. Compare the affected service and time window with the failure you observed.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: A client provided identifier for tracking this request.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
Only include results with the selected `status` value. Returns all results if omitted
  • ACTIVE - The upcoming maintenance is active.
  • CANCELLED - The upcoming maintenance has been cancelled.

parameters.name: modifiedAtAfter
parameters.description: Only include results with `modifiedAt` after the supplied date

parameters.name: startsAtAfter
parameters.description: Only include results with `startsAt` after the supplied date

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return

operations.title: Domain action history
operations.note: Inspect the action history for the customer and domain named in a support case. A queued action is not evidence that a requested change is complete.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: A client provided identifier for tracking this request.

parameters.name: customerId
parameters.description:
The Customer identifier
Note: For API Resellers, performing actions on behalf of your customers, you need to specify the Subaccount you're operating on behalf of; otherwise use your shopper id.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Domain whose actions are to be retrieved

intro: Start with the exact registered domain. Porkbun exposes registration, nameserver delegation, glue and hosted DNS as separate resources even when they describe the same name.

operations.title: Registered domains
operations.note: Inventory the domains visible to this API connection. Confirm per-domain API access when an expected registration is not visible.

parameters.name: X-API-Key
parameters.description: API key header auth (use with X-Secret-API-Key)

parameters.name: X-Secret-API-Key
parameters.description: Secret API key header auth (use with X-API-Key)

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Zero-based offset for pagination. Returns up to 1000 domains per call.

parameters.name: includeLabels
parameters.description: Return label metadata for each domain. Defaults to no.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Exact domain name match. Returns 0 or 1 result.

parameters.name: nameContains
parameters.description: Substring match against the full domain name. Case-insensitive.

parameters.name: expiringWithinDays
parameters.description: Filter to domains expiring within this many days.

parameters.name: tlds
parameters.description: Limit to these TLDs (no leading dot). Use bracket form: `?tlds[]=com&tlds[]=io`.

parameters.name: autoRenew
parameters.description: Filter to domains with auto-renew on or off.

parameters.name: apiAccess
parameters.description: Filter to domains opted in to API access.

parameters.name: sortName
parameters.description: Field to sort by. Default: `expire_date` ascending.

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Sort direction. Default: asc.

intro: Start with the zone for DNS questions and the account for developer services. A zone identifier cannot be substituted for an account identifier even when both belong to the same organization.

operations.title: Accessible DNS zones
operations.note: Discover zones visible to the current connection. Use the zone ID from this response for DNS lookups rather than copying an account ID.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: A domain name. Optional filter operators can be provided to extend refine the search: * `equal` (default) * `not_equal` * `starts_with` * `ends_with` * `contains` * `starts_with_case_sensitive` * `ends_with_case_sensitive` * `contains_case_sensitive`

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Specify a zone status to filter by.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Zone types to filter by. Multiple types can be specified as a comma-separated list (e.g., ?type=full,partial,secondary). When this parameter is not provided, zones with type "internal" are excluded from the results.

parameters.name: account.id
parameters.description: Filter by an account ID.

parameters.name: account.name
parameters.description: An account Name. Optional filter operators can be provided to extend refine the search: * `equal` (default) * `not_equal` * `starts_with` * `ends_with` * `contains` * `starts_with_case_sensitive` * `ends_with_case_sensitive` * `contains_case_sensitive`

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number of paginated results.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of zones per page.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Field to order zones by.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Direction to order zones.

parameters.name: match
parameters.description: Whether to match all search requirements or at least one (any).

operations.title: Zone status and details
operations.note: Inspect one zone when investigating onboarding or delegation. An account containing the zone is not proof that the registrar points to its assigned nameservers.

parameters.name: zone_id
parameters.description: Identifier

permissions: Access: Organizations, Identity Providers, and Groups Write

operations.title: Zone record inventory
operations.note: Filter and page through the records stored in a zone. A proxied record and a DNS-only record can produce different public answers.

parameters.name: zone_id
parameters.description: Identifier.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Exact value of the DNS record name. This is a convenience alias for `name.exact`.

parameters.name: name.exact
parameters.description: Exact value of the DNS record name. Name filters are case-insensitive.

parameters.name: name.contains
parameters.description: Substring of the DNS record name. Name filters are case-insensitive.

parameters.name: name.startswith
parameters.description: Prefix of the DNS record name. Name filters are case-insensitive.

parameters.name: name.endswith
parameters.description: Suffix of the DNS record name. Name filters are case-insensitive.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Record type.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Exact value of the DNS record content. This is a convenience alias for `content.exact`.

parameters.name: content.exact
parameters.description: Exact value of the DNS record content. Content filters are case-insensitive.

parameters.name: content.contains
parameters.description: Substring of the DNS record content. Content filters are case-insensitive.

parameters.name: content.startswith
parameters.description: Prefix of the DNS record content. Content filters are case-insensitive.

parameters.name: content.endswith
parameters.description: Suffix of the DNS record content. Content filters are case-insensitive.

parameters.name: proxied
parameters.description: Whether the record is receiving the performance and security benefits of Cloudflare.

parameters.name: match
parameters.description: Whether to match all search requirements or at least one (any). If set to `all`, acts like a logical AND between filters. If set to `any`, acts like a logical OR instead. Note that the interaction between tag filters is controlled by the `tag-match` parameter instead.

parameters.name: comment
parameters.description: Exact value of the DNS record comment. This is a convenience alias for `comment.exact`.

parameters.name: comment.present
parameters.description: If this parameter is present, only records *with* a comment are returned.

parameters.name: comment.absent
parameters.description: If this parameter is present, only records *without* a comment are returned.

parameters.name: comment.exact
parameters.description: Exact value of the DNS record comment. Comment filters are case-insensitive.

parameters.name: comment.contains
parameters.description: Substring of the DNS record comment. Comment filters are case-insensitive.

parameters.name: comment.startswith
parameters.description: Prefix of the DNS record comment. Comment filters are case-insensitive.

parameters.name: comment.endswith
parameters.description: Suffix of the DNS record comment. Comment filters are case-insensitive.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Condition on the DNS record tag. Parameter values can be of the form `<tag-name>:<tag-value>` to search for an exact `name:value` pair, or just `<tag-name>` to search for records with a specific tag name regardless of its value. This is a convenience shorthand for the more powerful `tag.<predicate>` parameters. Examples: - `tag=important` is equivalent to `tag.present=important` - `tag=team:DNS` is equivalent to `tag.exact=team:DNS`

parameters.name: tag.present
parameters.description: Name of a tag which must be present on the DNS record. Tag filters are case-insensitive.

parameters.name: tag.absent
parameters.description: Name of a tag which must *not* be present on the DNS record. Tag filters are case-insensitive.

parameters.name: tag.exact
parameters.description: A tag and value, of the form `<tag-name>:<tag-value>`. The API will only return DNS records that have a tag named `<tag-name>` whose value is `<tag-value>`. Tag filters are case-insensitive.

parameters.name: tag.contains
parameters.description: A tag and value, of the form `<tag-name>:<tag-value>`. The API will only return DNS records that have a tag named `<tag-name>` whose value contains `<tag-value>`. Tag filters are case-insensitive.

parameters.name: tag.startswith
parameters.description: A tag and value, of the form `<tag-name>:<tag-value>`. The API will only return DNS records that have a tag named `<tag-name>` whose value starts with `<tag-value>`. Tag filters are case-insensitive.

parameters.name: tag.endswith
parameters.description: A tag and value, of the form `<tag-name>:<tag-value>`. The API will only return DNS records that have a tag named `<tag-name>` whose value ends with `<tag-value>`. Tag filters are case-insensitive.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Allows searching in multiple properties of a DNS record simultaneously. This parameter is intended for human users, not automation. Its exact behavior is intentionally left unspecified and is subject to change in the future. This parameter works independently of the `match` setting. For automated searches, please use the other available parameters.

parameters.name: tag_match
parameters.description: Whether to match all tag search requirements or at least one (any). If set to `all`, acts like a logical AND between tag filters. If set to `any`, acts like a logical OR instead. Note that the regular `match` parameter is still used to combine the resulting condition with other filters that aren't related to tags.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number of paginated results.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of DNS records per page.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Field to order DNS records by.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Direction to order DNS records in.

parameters.name: include_shadow_metadata
parameters.description: Whether to include shadow metadata in the `meta` field of each record in the response. See [Shadowed records](https://developers.cloudflare.com/dns/manage-dns-records/reference/shadowed-records).

parameters.name: shadowed_by_name
parameters.description: Filters to records at or below the given NS delegation name, excluding the NS records that form the delegation itself. The value must be a subdomain of the zone; the zone apex is not accepted. Requires `include_shadow_metadata=true`. See [Shadowed records](https://developers.cloudflare.com/dns/manage-dns-records/reference/shadowed-records).

parameters.name: shadowing_name
parameters.description: Returns NS records that shadow the given name, searching at the name itself and each of its ancestor names within the zone, excluding the zone apex. The value must be a subdomain of the zone; the zone apex is not accepted. See [Shadowed records](https://developers.cloudflare.com/dns/manage-dns-records/reference/shadowed-records).

parameters.description: Bucket names to filter by. Only buckets with this phrase in their name will be returned.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Maximum number of buckets to return in a single call.

parameters.name: direction
